title: The Kola Superdeep Borehole
text: In 1970 Soviet geologists began a borehole on the Kola Peninsula and kept drilling for nineteen years. They reached 12 262 meters, still the deepest hole people have ever made. The rock ran hotter than predicted, the drilling stopped, and the site was abandoned. Around 1989 a story spread that the crew had lowered a microphone and recorded screams: the well to hell. The story was traced to a hoax. The reels in the capsule you found are real. Reel seven is not in any archive.
